children: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh said it would partially resume domestic and international flight operations on the 25th. According to Sina Finance, citing China Media Group reporter Wang Weiwei, Terminal 1 will handle domestic flights, while Terminal 2 will handle international flights operated by the national airline. The airport advised passengers to contact their airlines to confirm booking status and flight schedules before traveling to the airport. The airport had previously suspended operations after repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and energy facilities caused casualties.

title: Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport to Partially Resume Flights on the 25th
